watches.name: Complexity Métiers d'Art
watches.description: Unveiled as a world premiere at Watches & Wonders 2026, the Complexity established an architecture never before seen in the history of watchmaking: two inclined tourbillons, two Cônillons, positioned at 12 and 6 o'clock, coupled by a differential, within a case cut entirely from sapphire. ArtyA Genève now reveals its most accomplished interpretation: the Complexity Métiers d'Art. The principle is radical: every surface of the movement and dial becomes the territory of an artisan. Engraving, hammering, shot blasting, perlage, bevelling: the great decorative techniques of haute horlogerie are executed by hand, component by component, and orchestrated to invert the codes of the original version. Where the Complexity played on the purity of fine sandblasting, the Métiers d'Art asserts relief, texture and light. The same world premiere. The same exceptional calibre. An entirely new skin, born of the artisan's gesture.

specsRaw.Complication: Double Cônillon 12 / 6 o'clock with differential, a world premiere
specsRaw.Calibre: Proprietary Complexity-01, developed with Purtec Sàrl (Vallorbe)
specsRaw.Material: Synthetic sapphire, transparent through 360°, cut from the solid block
specsRaw.Form: Triple-concave middle, sapphire domes at 12 and 6 o'clock
specsRaw.Machining: More than 120 hours of diamond machining, more than 140 hours of polishing
specsRaw.Dial: Entirely hand engraved on a finely sandblasted base Indexes : Applied: hand polished bevels, cabron drawn flanks, sandblasted upper face
specsRaw.Indexes: Applied: hand polished bevels, cabron drawn flanks, sandblasted upper face
specsRaw.Bevelling: Hand bevelled and polished across the entire movement
specsRaw.Mainplate: Hand perlaged recesses, highlighting the differential
specsRaw.Centre bridge: Polished moulding opening the view onto the differential
specsRaw.Numbered plate: Hand engraved, exclusive to this edition
